content.value: A modem Kaplan turbine one-fourth of full size, develops 3.5 kW at 350 rpm under a head of 2.0 m. Find the speed and power of full size turbine operating under a head of 8.0 m if (i) the efficiency of the model and the full size turbine are same and (ii) the efficiency of the model turbine is 70% and the scale effect is considered.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year Special Backlog Examination, 2019
